name: Select to X
author: Ippoteck

sections.description:
Select to X enhances user engagement by allowing visitors to effortlessly share highlighted text from your website on Twitter. When a user selects any portion of text, a “Tweet” tooltip appears, enabling quick sharing without leaving the page.​

Features:

Lightweight and easy to use

No configuration required

Seamless integration with your site's content​
sections.installation:
Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.

In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New.

Click on Upload Plugin and select the downloaded ZIP file.

Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.​
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any configuration?

No, simply install and activate the plugin. It works out of the box.​

Can I customize the appearance of the “Tweet” tooltip?

Currently, customization options are not available. Future updates may include customization features.​

Is this plugin compatible with all themes?

The plugin is designed to work with most themes. If you encounter any issues, please report them on the GitHub Issues page.​

short_description: Select text on your website and tweet it instantly. A lightweight plugin that adds a "Tweet" tooltip when users highlight text.​
